newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland's AIB raises stake in Poland's WBK.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's AIB raises stake in Poland's WBK.

text.p: Irish commercial bank Allied Irish Banks Plc said on Tuesday its unit AIB European Investments Limited (AIB) had raised its stake in Poland's Wielkopolski Bank Kredytowy S.A. (WBK) to 60.2 percent from 45.7 percent.
AIB said its unit had bought the remaining 9,934,000 shares of WBK held by the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development(EBRD).
AIB had an option to acquire the stake under the terms of a deal agreed with the EBRD in early 1995.
AIB said the net price paid for the shares was equivalent to 29.3 million Irish pounds.
